top_homepage_problems: AIDA funnel inverted — portals appear before trust/value established; HowItWorks is section 10 instead of section 3
Two consecutive blocking overlays on first visit (CinematicIntro 4.4s + SmartPlatformTour auto-open 2.4s later)
35+ total CTAs with no hierarchy; all hero CTAs point to same scroll destination; /register CTA gated behind 4-quiz PathSelector
Portals shown 4 separate times (MarqueeStrip + ScrollStackSection + 3D Carousel + EcosystemMap) with no escalating depth
TechMarquee creates 320 simultaneously animating DOM nodes — single highest GPU cost on page
MotionProvider reducedMotion='never' globally overrides OS prefers-reduced-motion — WCAG 2.3.3 violation
Stats and social proof at section 11; zero real testimonials; one stat ('∞ Arabic Platform') damages credibility
ScrollStackSection (~2,200px tall) is flagged broken in June 2026 audit but still rendered
Old brand name 'أكاديمية درهوس' remains in ar.json footer copyright
PortalGrid.tsx exists but is never imported — dead code
wcag_violations_found: ScrollIndicator dots 6x6px — below WCAG touch target minimum (44x44px)
proposed_design_directions: Concept 1 — AI Command Center (OS Dashboard feel, portals as mission-critical widgets)
Concept 2 — The Learning Journey (narrative scroll, outcome-first, personalized path revelation)
Concept 3 — Silent Authority (minimal trust-first SaaS landing, no animation above fold)
Concept 4 — Portal Constellation (interactive map, each portal has its visual world)
Concept 5 — Goal Gateway (first question: 'What is your goal?' — everything adapts)
recommended_build_order: Concept 3 first (lowest complexity, validates shared foundation)
Concept 1 second (leverages existing dashboard mockup in HeroSection)
Concept 4 last (highest GPU cost, portal constellation map)
recommended_next_action: Build preview routes under /design-lab/ starting with Concept 3 (Silent Authority). Use 6-agent split defined in agent-work-allocation.md. No production homepage change until owner approves a preview.
